neighbours.label: the token right after a cell-division protein (cyclin, Aurora kinase, cohesin, PLK1), as opposed to the same frames with other proteins and gene symbols
fire: Levels of cyclin D1, p21 and actin were unchanged.
Phosphorylation of Aurora B and survivin rises in early mitosis.
The kinases CDK1 and PLK1 drive the cell into division.
Loss of securin, separase or cohesin causes errors in meiosis.
Expression of cyclin A and CDC20 peaks before anaphase.
Mutations in BUB1, MAD2 and BUBR1 disrupt the spindle checkpoint.
The cell cycle stalls when CDK2 and cyclin E are blocked.
Antibodies against Aurora A, TPX2 and tubulin stained the spindle.
quiet: Levels of IL6, TNF and actin were unchanged.
Phosphorylation of AKT1 and ERK2 rises in early exercise.
The enzymes amylase and lipase help the gut break down food.
Loss of collagen, elastin or keratin causes wrinkles in skin.
Expression of hemoglobin and myoglobin peaks before birth.
Mutations in CFTR, HBB and DMD disrupt the lungs, blood and muscle.
The carbon cycle stalls when rivers and lakes are frozen.
Antibodies against albumin, renin and nephrin stained the kidney.

notes: Card: ',' and ' and' after cyclin B1, Aurora A, REC8, plus 'iotic' and ' cycle'. Probes: 'cyclin B1,' 0.85, 'Aurora A and' 0.88, 'REC8,' 0.38, 'cell cycle ... by' 0.33; insulin, albumin, actin, titin 0.03 or less; water cycle 0.002. 'Graduation and' reached 0.29, as on the card, and is not explained. Output promotes ' heat', not explained.
